text:
Camila Ortiz: idea: run a 48-hour "Shoutout Sprint" next month where teams do a rapid, low-friction recognition push. mechanism: Slack threads + emoji reactions count, and top-reacted messages get a micro spot award automatically. thoughts?
Ben O: love the gamified feel. we should make it async-friendly for APAC folks. also need anti-gaming rules.
Yuki Sato: legal/HR: ok but require opt-in and clear rules. also we must avoid tying to performance reviews. add a short policy blurb.
Derek M: ops note: people-bot can probably automate reaction tallies, but we need a way to whitelist channels and exclude certain channels (e.g., interview feedback).
people-bot: Automation idea: use `/shoutout-sprint start --channels #eng,#product --duration 48h --min-reactions 3` to enable. Will DM moderators results and support `/issue-spot-award` integration.
James R: Finance: budget? propose $10 e-gifts for each sprint winner + 5 surprise $75 awards. cap $1k per sprint. any single award >$100 needs pre-approval.
Camila Ortiz: plan: 3 sprint waves (Americas, EMEA, APAC) staggered for timezone fairness, or run one global 48h window and use department-level leaderboards. Preference?
Ben O: staggered waves preferred to avoid reaction lag in off hours. also lets us celebrate regionally.
Yuki Sato: consent + data: include an opt-in toggle on the announcement and a link to a short FAQ explaining how reaction counts are used and data retention. I'll draft wording.
Derek M: moderation: nominate moderators (one per channel) to flag abuse. add a rule: self-nominations are allowed but not vote-pumping; repeated infractions remove eligibility.
people-bot: Suggestion: use `--no-self-vote` flag to ignore reactions from the message author and `--dedupe` to discount repeated reactions from the same user on the same message.
Camila Ortiz: volunteers: need 1 ops lead per wave + channel moderators. I'll make a signup sheet. also poster copy for Slack, explain rules and timeline.
Ben O: vendor note: e-gift vendor must support bulk CSV, e-mail delivery, and timezone scheduling. also need shipment options for office prizes.
James R: provisional budget OK. submit PO with vendor and tax ID at least 7 days before sprint. cc me.
Yuki Sato: policy blurb draft: "Shoutout Sprint is for peer recognition only. Do not use for performance calibration or compensation arguments. By participating you consent to having your name and shoutout displayed internally. Opt-out available."
Derek M: runbook: kickoff post, pinned rules, moderator checklist, post-sprint CSV with winners, automated issuance via people-bot. who can draft the runbook?
Camila Ortiz: I'll draft runbook + announcement. Derek can add automation steps. Yuki finalizes policy. Ben handles vendor. James approves budget.
people-bot: Automation note: after the sprint ends, moderators will receive a DM with top N messages per channel. Use `/issue-spot-award <recipient> <amount> <reason>` to distribute. Optionally, use `--auto-issue` to auto-award winners if finance pre-approves.
James R: auto-issue fine if pre-approved batch PO covers expected max. otherwise manual review. please add a PO buffer.
Camila Ortiz: timeline: announce 2 weeks out, PO + vendor 1 week out, moderator training 3 days out, sprint runs for 48h.
Ben O: small UX ask: include a Slack shortcut in the post to flag a shoutout as "overtime safe" for folks who want recognition without public posting.
Yuki Sato: also add an appeals flow in case someone objects to a shoutout. simple email to people-ops.
Camila Ortiz: action items: Camila draft announcement + runbook; Derek build people-bot flags and moderator DM flow; Ben confirm vendor; Yuki finalize policy; James approve PO buffer. closing for now, will reopen with drafts. :sparkles:
